title: 第214章 贵族异动贝儿的应对方式第213章 坏了又让卡拉波斯爽到了
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
伴随着一声龙吼，奥罗拉的身影出现在内昂城的天空之上，振翅飞向了远处的祈愿山城堡。
市政厅办公室中的贝儿，透过窗户看着奥罗拉的身影，沉声道：
“如今凯南大人正在为解救王都卢泰西亚中沉睡的民众而忙碌着，所以必须要阻止王国那些贵族们的暗中异动，不能让凯南大人分心！”
说到这里，贝儿当即转过身来，看向了仙蒂瑞拉道：
“消息可靠吗？”
仙蒂瑞拉小脸严肃，点了点头道：
“这是商队从各个地方传回来的情报，爱洛公主的身份引起了许多人的怀疑猜忌，尤其是王国内的贵族们异动频频，甚至已经有人想要联络科罗纳王国……”
如今的仙蒂瑞拉，已然开始接手内昂城的情报系统。
李凯南让一名十几岁、此前只是被养在深闺的少女担任如此重任，多少是有些离谱，就连她的父亲皮埃尔都不然太认可。
但李凯南却不觉得有什么，毕竟仙蒂瑞拉也是系统看好的“人才”，甚至还拥有听懂动物语言、驱使动物的能力。
在这个拥有超凡生物的世界之中，仙蒂瑞拉的能力其实是很恐怖的。
让她负责情报系统，只能算是大材小用！
再加上李凯南向来是“任人唯亲”，执掌内昂城大权的贝儿年龄其实也就比仙蒂瑞拉大个两三岁……
……
此时贝儿闻言，却是微微皱眉继续问道：
“他们想要联系科罗纳王国？”
“是的……”
仙蒂瑞拉点了点头，然后继续道：
“我的动物朋友们看到了这些贵族们派出的队伍，想要前往科罗纳王国寻找一位王子！”
作为此前跟着李凯南一起经历过亚当城堡之事的贝儿，她自然清楚那位王子就是亚当王子。

李凯南当初得以高举王室正统大旗，就是因为打着亚当王子的旗号。
在如今卡佩国王、王后遇难，爱洛公主身份遭到质疑的情况下，亚当王子自然重新成为了王室唯一的代言人！
贝儿神色更加凝重了，沉声道：
“他们为什么会知道亚当王子在科罗纳王国？”
卡佩王国乱了十年，某些大贵族们早已产生了野心，此前不过是畏惧于李凯南的威势而选择蛰伏而已。
甚至就连那边原先支持李凯南的保王党贵族们，这些年来也习惯了没有管束，心中未必愿意接受李凯南这样的强势人物成为新国王……
这样的情况下，他们想要迎回亚当王子也很正常。
但问题是，他们是怎么知道亚当王子在科罗纳王国的？
当初亚当王子前去科罗纳王国，是特意隐藏了身份。
为了吸引卡拉波斯的注意，当时李凯南还一路打着亚当王子的旗号，导致外界大都以为亚当王子就在内昂城！
可是如今这些贵族们，居然能够知道亚当王子跑去了科罗纳王国……
仙蒂瑞拉闻言，连忙道：
“如今只知道是有人给这些贵族们传递了消息……我已经让我的动物朋友们立即行动起来，相信很快就能够得到答案！”
content_en:
With a dragon roar, Aurora's figure appeared in the sky of Neang City, fluttering its wings and flying towards the Castle of Prayer Mountain in the distance.
Belle in the city hall office looked at Aurora through the window and said in a deep voice:
"Now Lord Kennen is busy rescuing the sleeping people in the royal capital of Lutecia, so we must prevent the secret movements of the nobles in the kingdom and not let Lord Kennen be distracted!"
Having said this, Belle immediately turned around, looked at Cinderella and said:
"Is the news reliable?"
Cinderella's face was serious, she nodded and said:
"This is information sent back by caravans from various places. Princess Aurora's identity has aroused suspicion and jealousy among many people, especially the nobles in the kingdom who are making frequent changes. Some people even want to contact the Kingdom of Corona..."
Today, Xiandiruila has begun to take over the intelligence system of Neang City.
It was somewhat outrageous for Li Kainan to let a teenage girl who had only been raised in a boudoir take on such an important responsibility. Even her father Pierre didn't quite agree with it.
But Li Kainan didn't think it was a big deal. After all, Cinderella was also a "talent" favored by the system, and even had the ability to understand animal language and drive animals.
In this world with extraordinary creatures, Cinderella's ability is actually very terrifying.
Putting her in charge of the intelligence system can only be regarded as overkill!
In addition, Li Kainan has always been a "nepotist", and Belle, who is in charge of the power of Neang City, is actually only two or three years older than Cinderella...
…
When Belle heard this, she frowned slightly and continued to ask:
"They want to contact the Kingdom of Corona?"
"Yes..."
Cinderella nodded, and then continued:
"My animal friends saw the team sent by these nobles and wanted to go to the Kingdom of Corona to find a prince!"
As Belle, who had experienced the Adam Castle incident with Li Kainan before, she naturally knew that the prince was Prince Adam.
Li Kainan was able to hold high the banner of royal orthodoxy in the first place because he was under the banner of Prince Adam.
Now that King and Queen Capet have been killed and Princess Aurora's identity has been questioned, Prince Adam has naturally become the only spokesperson of the royal family again!
Belle's expression became more solemn and she said in a deep voice:
"Why do they know that Prince Adam is in the Kingdom of Corona?"
The Cape Kingdom has been in chaos for ten years, and some of the great nobles have already developed ambitions. Before, they were just afraid of Li Kainan's power and chose to stay dormant.
Even the royalist nobles who originally supported Li Kainan have become accustomed to lack of control over the years, and may not be willing to accept a strong figure like Li Kainan as the new king...
Under such circumstances, it is normal for them to want to welcome Prince Adam back.
But the question is, how did they know that Prince Adam was in the Kingdom of Corona?
When Prince Adam went to the Kingdom of Corona, he deliberately hid his identity.
In order to attract Carabosse's attention, Li Kainan also used the banner of Prince Adam all the way, causing most outsiders to think that Prince Adam was in Neang City!
But now these nobles actually know that Prince Adam ran away to the Kingdom of Corona...
Hearing this, Cinderella quickly said:
"Now I only know that someone sent the message to these nobles... I have asked my animal friends to take action immediately, and I believe I will get the answer soon!"
